zhang-qian-western-mission.description: A bearded man in a dark layered robe and a tall black cap rides a grey horse across open grassland under a heavy storm sky. He holds a long pole topped with a bundle of tufted fur or feathers. Two more riders leading pack horses follow in the background. No text, border or frame is visible, and nothing is violent.

cleopatra-meets-antony-tarsus.description: A gilded galley with a purple canopy and gold-carved hull sits on dark water, oars extended. Several women in white and gold robes attend a reclining woman in the stern under the canopy. On the right bank, armoured soldiers with spears and round shields, one in a red cloak and crested helmet, stand near a classical temple on a hill. Painterly oil style, warm late-afternoon light, no visible text or frame.

roman-embassy-han-court.description: An oil-style painting of an interior hall with dark carved wood pillars and gold-patterned screens. On a raised dais a bearded man in a black robe and tall black hat sits, with attendants in dark robes and hats standing beside him. In the foreground, bearded men in rough, worn cloaks and tunics kneel on a patterned carpet; one arranges large ivory tusks, and a dark horn-like object lies on the floor. A bearded man in a brown cloak on the right gestures with open hands. No visible text or frame.

abul-abbas-elephant-charlemagne.description: A large grey elephant with ivory tusks and a patterned saddle cloth is led on a rope by a bearded man in a white turban and robes, with a second handler behind it. Torches burn at left and centre, and figures in mail and a crowned man in gold robes stand in a stone-arched courtyard with a second stone building behind.

ibn-fadlan-volga-embassy.description: An oil-style painting of a bearded man in a dark turban and black layered robes sits at right, writing with a stylus on a wooden tablet. Behind him on a grey, misty riverbank, fur-clad men with axes and a tattooed warrior stand by a longship, barrels and a fire. A sword and axe lie in the foreground at bottom left. There is no visible text, frame or border, and nothing graphic.

carpini-mission-great-khan.description: A hooded man in a grey, tattered robe stands in the foreground holding a parchment with three red wax seals. Behind him, mounted warriors in lamellar armour and fur-trimmed collars sit on horses, with a felt yurt with an ornate doorway and red banners under a stormy sky. The scene is a dim, painterly landscape with no visible frame.

rabban-sauma-embassy-europe.description: An oil-style painting of a bearded man in a dark grey hooded robe with a leather belt and pouch, bowing forward and holding a folded document. He faces a seated figure in white and gold papal vestments wearing a jewelled tiara, with red-robed cardinals standing around in a stone arched hall, and a bearded man in a pale robe behind him. The scene is edge to edge with no visible text, border or signature. Nothing is gory or nude.

clavijo-embassy-timur.description: A night scene inside a richly hung tent pavilion with patterned red and gold textiles. An elderly bearded man in a white turban and fur-trimmed embroidered robe sits on a red cushioned throne. Two men in dark doublets kneel on a rug in the foreground, one holding a paper and gesturing toward him. Attendants in dark robes and mail stand around, torches and oil lamps light the scene, and trees and another tent are visible through the open side. No text, no frame.

matteo-ricci-enters-beijing.description: A bearded man in a black robe and black square hat holds a gilded mantel clock on a red cloth tray, with a rolled map under his arm. He faces an older man in a gold robe who gestures with open hands, with other officials in dark robes behind. They stand before a large open red gate with studded doors, and a palace hall with curved roofs and incense smoke is visible beyond. An armoured guard in red and lacquer stands at the left edge. The clock dial has numerals but no readable text, and the image fills the frame edge to edge.

hasekura-embassy-rome.description: A painted interior of a grand Renaissance-style hall with marble columns, frescoed walls and arched windows. A Japanese man in a gold-patterned brocade robe and dark armoured sleeves bows low with a katana at his waist, facing a seated pope in red and white on a raised throne at right. Kneeling figures in dark habits and gold garments sit at left, with cardinals in red, a Swiss Guard in striped uniform and a halberd, and other onlookers standing behind. No text, no frame, nothing graphic.

siamese-embassy-louis-xiv.description: A painted palace hall with gilded arched windows, candelabras and a dark gilt canopy. Kneeling men in brocade robes and tall golden conical crowns hold a golden casket toward a seated, richly robed figure on a throne at the far right. Onlookers in periwigs and dark European dress stand around the room, and a red-robed figure kneels with hands pressed together at the lower right. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text.

peter-great-grand-embassy.description: A dark-haired man with a moustache, in a loose white shirt with rolled sleeves and a dark leather apron, swings an axe into the curved wooden hull of a ship in a busy shipyard. Tall-masted ships, other workers, wood shavings, mallets and a rope-strewn floor fill the background and foreground. It is a dark, painterly oil style with no visible text, and the painting runs edge to edge with no frame.

iwakura-mission-west.description: A group of men in dark kimono with topknots and men in Western frock coats and top hats come down a wooden gangway from a black-hulled steamship with a tall funnel and smoke, onto a wet cobbled quay at dusk. Gas lamps and onlookers in flat caps and top hats stand around. A man in a dark kimono and a man in a top hat carry a case. Rigging, ropes and a few distant masts are visible. The image is a full-bleed painting with no frame or text.

bjorko-meeting-kaiser-tsar.description: Two large white and black steam-and-sail vessels with multiple masts lie side by side on dark water in a pine-fringed bay under a stormy sky, a small steam launch crossing between them. No people are visible. No text, frame or border is visible; the painting fills the image edge to edge.

vienna-summit-kennedy-khrushchev.description: Two long black limousines with small flags sit on a wet courtyard in front of a lit, ornate stone villa with a tall wrought-iron gate. Two tripod-mounted film or TV cameras with cable coils stand in the foreground, and a case sits on the ground. The scene is dusk, painted in an oil style with no people visible and no text.

sadat-visits-jerusalem.description: A silver twin-engine airliner stands at night on a floodlit tarmac, its forward door open with a boarding staircase and a red carpet running from the steps. Searchlight beams rise behind it and rows of flags on poles line both sides. The jet has a dark stripe along the fuselage, and the scene is painted in loose, dark, oil-like brushwork. No people, text or frame are visible.

reykjavik-summit-reagan-gorbachev.description: A pale grey wooden house with a steep gabled roof stands alone on dark, rocky ground beside a rough sea under a heavy, stormy sky. A warm-lit window shows two armchairs and a small table inside. A dark fence runs along the right and a boxy older car sits by the road. No people, no text.
